title: Web Design & Development
description: A web presence built to work like part of the business, not just a brochure — fast, responsive, and structured to convert visitors into customers, using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

title: Backend & System Development
description: The backend behind a business with real operational complexity — authentication, business logic, admin tooling, and APIs built with .NET, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Supabase to handle actual workflows, not just simple CRUD.

title: Mobile App Development
description: A mobile app that extends day-to-day operations — for customers or for the team running the business — built cross-platform with React Native and Flutter from a single codebase.

title: AI Automation & Workflows
description: Automating the repetitive parts of running a business — lead handling, support replies, CRM updates, notifications, reporting — with n8n, AI agents, and custom integrations, so the team spends less time on manual work.

title: Database Architecture & API Integration
description: A data layer a growing business can actually rely on — schemas, queries, and APIs designed with PostgreSQL, Prisma, Supabase, and SQL Server that hold up as transactions, integrations, and usage pile up.

title: UI/UX Design & Prototyping
description: Interfaces designed around how a business actually operates day to day — wireframed and prototyped in Figma, then built into pixel-perfect, conversion-focused screens.
